payload.reason: The re-ranking approach described in the paper is applied to improve the performance of an already deployed QA system without retraining, which aligns with the characteristics of transductive learning.

claims.text: The re-ranking approach improves the performance of deployed QA systems without requiring retraining, indicating it is a transductive learning technique.
The method learns from the top-10 candidates and their initial confidences, which is consistent with transductive learning principles.
